core.why: This segment is most likely to try new menu items and seek out local, artisanal coffee experiences, especially when paired with a discount. They are in the prime demographic for spontaneous weekend outings and are influenced by social sharing and local buzz.

spillover.why: These age groups are also likely to be in the area and may visit for the discount or to experience the new drink, even if they are not the primary target. They are more likely to be influenced by social media posts and local event announcements.

decision.headline: Launch version B: it won every seed by more than the interval.
reasons: The simulated gap is 24.4 points (B 51.2% vs A 26.8%), inside a ±20.4-point interval: version B wins every seed and clears the interval.
A real test needs about 62 people per version to detect a gap that small (5% two-sided, 80% power): 124 in all.
There are about 27,006 Instagram users in Austin, TX 78704 (Census x Pew join), so that test would have to reach 0.5% of them.
A test using at most 20.0% of the local audience (2,700 per version) can only detect a gap of about 3.8 points, so the next version must move intent by at least that much to be worth testing.
